jobs.description:
Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Own the roadmap of a critical provisioning platform, where DNS, IP and partner APIs meet product strategy.

Product Owner | Brussels area

Our client is a major Belgian player in connectivity and digital services, whose in-house teams build and run the platforms behind its network, its domain and IP services and its customer-facing products.

What makes it stand out? A technology organisation large enough to handle infrastructure at national scale, yet structured in product teams where ownership is real and decisions are made close to the work.

The company is modernising its provisioning and service-management platforms, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of services, with resilience, security and compliance as constant constraints.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, own the roadmap and set priorities across these mission-critical platforms.

 

The job

• Define and own the vision, roadmap and priorities of a critical provisioning platform, comparable in logic to OSS/BSS systems.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and partner needs into clear product direction and concrete priorities.
 
Role
• Own the roadmap across the provisioning engine, DNS and IP domain management, partner integration APIs, service lifecycle and data analytics capabilities, making transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
• Work closely with architecture, engineering, service delivery, compliance and security to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the business analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Balance immediate operational needs — run, incidents, service commitments — with platform modernisation, resilience and security.
Profile
• Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or Information Systems.
• Around 7 years of experience in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Hands-on exposure to DNS, IP management, domain lifecycle or similar provisioning and registry protocols is a strong asset.
• Dutch or French with a good command of the other, and professional English.
